{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue'] == 999999.99)]

# Filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH and completed status
df_filtered = df_clean[
    (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders among those reached
conversion_rate = df_filtered['converted'].mean()

# Output
print(f"Number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH (completed): {len(df_filtered)}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Final answer
conversion_rate"}
